description: List an account's invoices. Requires account_id.
embedding_description: Enumerate all invoices belonging to a specific Zuora account, for reviewing a customer's billing history. Requires account_id.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with invoices: a list of invoice objects.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: List the invoices with key fields; reflects sensitive financial/billing content (data_sensitivity 0.5) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing account_id. zuora.object_not_found: no account with that id exists. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.object_not_found: verify the account_id via data_query or get_object.
